summary: Resolves a value through helper sub_5644B0 applied to global byte_5EA438 and passes the result to strcmp twice (the decompiled body feeds the same expression to both operands), then returns the negated comparison when the dword at dword_8D46B4 + 132 is zero. Net effect is a signed comparison whose direction depends on a flag inside the object pointed to by dword_8D46B4; if sub_5644B0 is deterministic the two operands are identical and the comparison degenerates to zero.

operations.description: Call sub_5644B0(byte_5EA438) and store the returned pointer as v0.
Call strcmp(sub_5644B0(byte_5EA438), v0); both operands derive from the same helper call on the same global, so the result is zero unless sub_5644B0 is stateful or has side effects.
If the dword at dword_8D46B4 + 132 (offset 132 bytes into the object pointed to by the global) is zero, return the negated strcmp result.
Return the strcmp result when the dword at dword_8D46B4 + 132 is non-zero.

unresolved: Identity and semantics of helper sub_5644B0 (name/string resolution?).
Whether sub_5644B0 is deterministic; if so both strcmp operands are identical and the comparison always yields zero.
Type and role of the object at dword_8D46B4 and of its field at offset 132.
Purpose of the negated vs non-negated comparison direction.
